Absorb 3x as Much, 2x Faster

Absorbs three times more and twice as fast to pull moisture away quickly and lock it in. Keeps your baby drier for longer stretches, which means fewer disruptions at night and more sleep for everyone

Advanced Blowout Protection

Designed with secure leak guards and a snug fit to help contain messes before they escape. Fewer outfit changes, fewer surprises, and more confidence wherever the day takes you.

Snuggly Waistband

Our Snuggly Waistband wraps gently yet securely around your little one, giving a soft hold that stays in place through every wiggle and stretch. Designed to fit snug without squeezing and preventing pressure marks. Perfect for growing babies who need comfort, protection, and freedom to move all day long.

Cloud Soft Wonder

Buttery-soft materials feel gentle against delicate skin while maintaining dependable protection. Reduces friction and keeps your baby cozy, and happy through every cuddle, nap, and adventure.

60% Thinner with Cloudfresh™

Unlike conventional bulky diapers that trap heat and moisture, our thin, breathable design lets air circulate to help prevent diaper rashes.

Simply Hygienic

Resealable Daily Packs keep diapers sealed fresh and protected from dust and moisture. Perfectly portioned to help you stay organized at home or tossing a pack in the diaper bag on your way out.

FAQs

Just like our diapers, the pants aren't just cute, they are designed with a simple purpose: to simplify your parenting journey. We've sourced the latest high-performance, premium, skin-loving materials and clean ingredients available on the market. The result is an ultra-soft, hypoallergenic diaper that's gentle on your baby's delicate skin to help prevent diaper rashes.

Our pants feature a powerful absorbent core that locks in moisture and minimizes the chance of leaks or messy blowouts—90% of customers who provided feedback reported experiencing fewer leaks and blowouts. In our lab testing (Size 5), each pants held over 40+ fl oz of liquid, keeping your baby dry and comfortable for longer stretches—even through the night.

Other than that, the pants also feature our innovative Bubbly Waistbands—designed to gently hug your child's belly for a secure, comfortable fit without pressing or leaving marks. As your little one becomes more active, this thoughtful design moves with them, providing all-day comfort whether they're crawling, climbing, or exploring their world.

Every product undergoes rigorous testing and certification processes from independent third-party organizations including FDA, SGS, and CPSC. We also listen closely to customer feedback to continuously improve our product quality.

For more details, visit our Safety & Certification page to find out what sets us apart.

Every baby grows and develops at their own pace—there's no one-size-fits-all answer. You know your little one best, and we're here to offer some guidance to help you decide when the time might be right.

Consider trying The Pant if:

  • Your baby is wearing The Diaper size 3 or larger and has become especially active—crawling, rolling, or wiggling during diaper changes
  • Your baby is approaching the upper weight limit of their current diaper size
  • You're preparing for potty training—The Pant offers a more "underwear-like" feel and supports a baby-led approach, helping your little one practice pulling pants up and down

The Pant is designed to move with your growing baby, offering flexibility and comfort during every stage of their journey.

For sizing assistance, please visit our Sizing Guide.

The quantity varies by size to match your baby's changing needs. As babies grow, they typically soil pants less frequently, requiring fewer pants—though each pants uses more material.

Here's a quick breakdown:

Size 3 ( 19-30 lbs ): 128 pants

Size 4 ( 26+ lbs ): 128 pants

Size 5 ( 33+ lbs ): 112 pants

Size 6 ( 37+ lbs ): 96 pants

Still unsure? Visit our Sizing Guide for more details.

Our pants boxes are designed to keep your little one comfortable for approximately one month, though this depends on your baby's age and changing routine. We recommend 4-7 diaper changes per day for optimal comfort and skin health.

We understand that growth spurts happen! Enjoy the flexibility to adjust your delivery schedule based on your needs. Simply log into your Account page or email us at hello@alppibaby.com—we're happy to help.

Like our diaper, our pants are designed with care in the US and manufactured responsibly in China. We thoughtfully selected our manufacturing partners for their industry-leading quality and standards. They produce products for many globally recognized brands, are certified with ISO standards, and align with our non-toxic, clean core values.

We take pride in our non-toxic values. Our pants are free from harmful chemicals and irritants—no fragrances, lotions, latex, rubber, dyes, alcohol, heavy metals, parabens, phthalates, pesticides, chlorine bleaching, VOCs, or optical brighteners.

Here are what they are made of,

Absorbent Core: Totally Chlorine Free (TCF) super absorbent core with Sodium Polyacrylate (SAP)

Topsheet & Backsheet: Polyester & Polypropylene

Soft Cover: Breathable Non-woven fabrics

Seams & Joints: Solvent-free Adhesives

Waist & Leg Cuffs: Bubbly elastic bands & Polypropylene

Wetness Indicator: pH-Sensitive Strip

Prints: Safe and Non-sensitizing inks

While many brands price their pants higher than diapers, at Alppi we've chosen to keep them the same. We believe parents should be free to choose what's best for their little ones—without being influenced by a price difference.

Whether you prefer the classic fit of our diapers or the flexibility of our pants, you'll get the same:

  • Premium, high-performance materials sourced from industry-leading partners
  • Clean, skin-loving ingredients free from harmful chemicals and irritants
  • Thoughtful design focused on comfort for babies and peace of mind for parents
  • Convenient direct-to-door delivery

All at fair, competitive pricing compared to other premium brands.

At Alppi, the choice is yours—and either way, you're choosing quality.

Yes. We've included a pH-sensitive wetness indicator that turns blue when wet or soiled, allowing you to quickly and reliably know when it's time for a change.

Our pants are designed with a high-waist to provide a snug, comfortable fit that helps prevent blowouts even for active babies. This design may make them appear larger than other brands.

For sizing assistance, please visit our Sizing Guide.

Creating a bulky pants is easy—creating a thin, breathable, highly absorbent pants is the real challenge. Imagine wearing a thick sanitary pad for hours: bacteria and germs thrive in that environment.

Babies wear pants day and night for at least 18 months, making breathability essential for their delicate skin. By allowing air to circulate, our breathable pants help prevent rashes and keep your baby's skin dry, healthy, and comfortable all day long.

Using the latest high-performance materials, we've achieved a pants that is 60% thinner than conventional pants while maintaining superior softness and absorbency—holding over 40+ fl oz of liquid (tested with Size 5) to keep your baby dry through the night.

Our pants feature our innovative Bubbly Waistbands—designed to gently hug your child's belly for a secure, comfortable fit without pressing or leaving marks. As your little one becomes more active, this thoughtful design moves with them, providing all-day comfort whether they're crawling, climbing, or exploring their world.

Yes, it does! The toss tab on the back of our pants is designed to make disposal quick, hygienic, and hassle-free. Simply roll up the soiled pants, use the tab to seal it securely, and toss it in the bin.

To keep your baby comfortable and prevent rashes, we recommend changing pants as soon as they become soiled. Our wetness indicator provides a clear signal from yellow to blue when it's time for a change. Most families find 4-7 pants changes per day maintains healthy, comfortable skin.

Absolutely! Our diapers and pants are designed for both day and night use. With advanced blowout protection and our superior absorbent core, they keep your baby fresh and dry throughout the night—helping everyone enjoy more comfortable, uninterrupted sleep.

Our pants are intended for single use only. Once soiled, they should be disposed of promptly.

Yes. Alppi pants are specifically designed for delicate skin, including babies prone to eczema or sensitivity. They are free from all common triggers: fragrances, lotions, latex, rubber, dyes, alcohol, heavy metals, parabens, phthalates, pesticides, chlorine bleaching, VOCs, and optical brighteners.

Every pants is dermatologist-tested, hypoallergenic, and third-party lab certified. Many parents reported that after switching to Alppi, their babies are relieved and free from diaper rashes.

Visit our Safety & Certifications page for more details.

While some brands market pants as recyclable or compostable, the reality is that no fully recyclable or biodegradable pants currently exist on the market. We've thoroughly evaluated all available materials.

Our pants are not fully recyclable or biodegradable. However, we select eco-friendly and biodegradable materials for certain components and maintain clean manufacturing processes as part of our commitment to sustainable development—a core value guiding our current and future product development.

Therefore, please dispose of pants responsibly in a trash or designated diaper bin.

Shipping & Returns

We currently ship to all 48 contiguous US states. We do not ship to PO Boxes, APO, FPO, DPO addresses, or US territories.

  • Free shipping: Orders $30+ (48 contiguous states)
  • Subscription orders: Always ship free
  • Orders under $30 (including samples): $5.97 shipping fee
  • Processing: 1-3 business days from our California warehouse
  • Transit: 3-7 business days depending on location

Warehouses are closed weekends and major holidays. You'll receive tracking information via email once your order ships.

If you have any questions about your order status, please reach out to us at hello@alppibaby.com.

Our warehouse processes and ships orders within 1-3 business days. We can cancel or change the shipping address before the orders have been shipped out, but if the orders has been shipped out already, please email us at hello@alppibaby.com and we’ll do our best to help.

You can always make changes to or cancel your subscription in your Account page. We’ll also send you an email 7 days before your next shipment processes, giving you the ability to make any changes.

Visit our Tracking page or email hello@alppibaby.com.

Please email hello@alppibaby.com with your order number and photos, and we'll make it right.

We are one of the few brands that are able to accept returns for diapering products due to our thoughtful and convenient packaging.

To be eligible for return:

  • Returns are accepted within 30 days of purchase
  • Items must be unopened, unused, and in original packaging
  • A $15 logistics & handling fee applies to returns

Not eligible for return/refund:

  • Gifts and sale items
  • Personal care items (wipes) for hygiene and safety reasons

If you received a size that's too large, consider keeping it—babies grow quickly and will likely fit into it soon!

To initiate a return, review our full Return & Refund Policy, then visit our Return Center.

Account , Subscriptions & Billing

Our subscription program ensures you never run out of baby essentials while saving time and money. Benefits include:

We'll email you 7 days before each shipment processes, giving you time to make changes. You can edit size, shipping address, billing information, frequency, delay, skip, or cancel anytime through your Account page or by emailing hello@alppibaby.com.

Yes, anytime through your Account page or by emailing hello@alppibaby.com.

Log into your Account page to:

  • Update diaper size
  • Switch between diapers and pants
  • Adjust delivery dates

All changes apply to your next order. For additional help, email hello@alppibaby.com.

Your card will be charged when your next order processes. Depending on your selected frequency (2-6 weeks), we'll email you 7 days before each shipment.

To switch between products, simply log into your Account page or email hello@alppibaby.com.
